description: BenchKeeper sets up Claude Code and Codex with one rules file and four skills. The setup skills install and check rules, skills and tools at pinned versions, per machine and per repository; the following-dev-workflow skill sizes each request, so small changes skip the steps they do not need.

core.name: agent-skills
core.role: its skills drive each SDLC phase (specify, plan, tests first, build, review, ship); BenchKeeper pins and configures them and sizes each task

prerequisites.name: GitHub CLI
prerequisites.for: issues and pull requests (optional, local branches without it)

parallelTools.name: Orca
points: one git worktree per agent; the same prompt across several agents to compare results
terminal splits, SSH remote worktrees, mobile companion app
`/setting-up-machine` offers its `orca-cli` and `orchestration` skills after asking
parallelTools.when: you want terminal-based parallel agents with worktrees, remote machines or mobile access

parallelTools.name: Nimbalyst
points: parallel sessions on a kanban board, one-click worktree per session
every agent edit arrives as a diff you approve or reject
visual editors (Markdown, CSV, mockups, diagrams), task tracking, iOS app
parallelTools.when: you review changes visually and work on docs, mockups and tasks next to the agents

parallelTools.name: cmux
points: notifications when an agent needs input; sidebar with branch, PR status and ports
parallelTools.when: you are on macOS and want a terminal without a separate app

openhands.name: OpenHands
openhands.summary: A self-hosted agent server with a web UI that runs work without you at the terminal.
points: Each conversation can run in its own Docker container (`OH_CONVERSATION_RUNTIME=docker`), an isolation option BenchKeeper does not provide.
Runs its own agent or hosts Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI; works with any LLM.
Automations on a schedule or on webhook events (GitHub, Slack, Linear), for example splitting GitHub issues into tasks.
Without a sandbox, the local agent has full access to your filesystem.
Unverified: whether agents inside its containers load the BenchKeeper rules and skills, which are installed on the host.

sdlc.requirements: Requests come from you, GitHub issues, Jira, Linear and other trackers, bug reports, reviews and Maintain findings; only GitHub issues are automated.

steps.name: Understand
steps.tip: Reads the request, AGENTS.md and the code it touches. No edits yet.
steps.text: Read the request, `AGENTS.md` and the code the change touches before any edit.

steps.name: Track
steps.tip: Standard and full tiers: turns the request into a GitHub issue with goal, acceptance criteria and tasks. You approve it.
steps.text: Standard and full tiers without an issue: the agent drafts title, goal, acceptance criteria and tasks, and creates the issue after your approval.

steps.name: Branch
steps.text: `<type>/<issue>-<slug>`, or `<type>/<slug>` without an issue; no work on the default branch unless you say so.

steps.name: Specify
steps.tip: Full tier: writes the spec as an OpenSpec change or in plan mode, with deployment, storage, module boundaries and core types.
steps.text: Full tier: `spec-driven-development`, as an OpenSpec change when the repository has one. It records deployment target, data storage, module boundaries and core types; a skeleton comes first only on request or in a repository without structure.

steps.name: Plan
steps.tip: Full tier: breaks the spec into small tasks with acceptance criteria.
steps.text: Full tier: `planning-and-task-breakdown` into small tasks with acceptance criteria.

steps.name: Build
steps.tip: Implements task by task, tests first, the smallest complete change.
steps.text: `incremental-implementation`, tests first where a suite exists, Ponytail `full` for the smallest complete change. Work that drifts from the plan is discarded and restarted, with the cause added to the plan.

steps.name: Verify
steps.tip: Runs build, types, lint and tests in the devcontainer; checks UI changes in a browser.
steps.text: Build, types, lint and tests inside the devcontainer; UI changes in a browser through Playwright MCP.

steps.name: Review
steps.tip: Standard and full tiers, and risky quick changes: correctness review of the commits before push. Findings wait for you.
steps.text: Standard and full tiers, and risky quick changes: correctness review of the commits before `git push` (diff, touched code, plan), plus `security-review` for risky changes. Findings stop the push until you decide.

steps.name: Ship
steps.tip: Opens a draft pull request, waits for checks, marks it ready. You merge.
steps.text: Draft pull request with `Closes #n` when an issue exists and the key decisions; wait for checks, mark ready. Merge only on your instruction.

steps.name: Maintain
steps.tip: On request (/maintaining-repos), suggested after a milestone or a large merge: audit, debt, dependencies, docs drift, unused skills. Findings become new requests.
steps.text: On request (`/maintaining-repos`), suggested after a milestone or a large merge: `ponytail-audit`, `ponytail-debt`, dependency audit, docs drift, `/doctor prompt-audit`, `/skill-doctor`, repository hygiene. Findings become new requests.
